current_evidence: The council's 'Validating your application' page is the only live validation source: it lists the 'validation guidance', the 'local validation checklist for planning applications' and the 'comprehensive checklist', but marks each '[Currently being updated]' with no document link, and searches of darlington.gov.uk found no newer published local list (an old /media/2260/introduction.pdf now returns 404).

issues.detail: The workbook's 'Validation list URL' is the Design and Access Statements topic sub-page, not a local validation list. The council's formal local validation checklist is not published at present: it is marked 'Currently being updated'. The workbook should point to the 'Validating your application' page and say that no current local list document is available, not record the status as 'Captured'.
issues.evidence: Validating your application page: 'This document is a list of items that could be requested by the planning authority and is currently being updated.' The validation guidance and the local validation checklist are both marked '[Currently being updated]'.

issues.detail: The List date 2025-02-01 does not match the workbook's own date basis ('updated on 21 February 2025'), and that date is only the last-updated date of the DAS web page. It is not an adoption or publication date for a local list. The main validation page shows no date, and no dated local list is published.
issues.evidence: DAS page footer: 'This page was last updated on 21 February 2025'. The Validating your application page shows no last-updated date.

issues.detail: Heritage Statement not captured. The source requires it for Listed Building Consent and Conservation Area Consent applications, for work affecting scheduled monuments or listed buildings, and for development in conservation areas. As a result, Householder, Listed building consent and Demolition in cons area wrongly show only the DAS or '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Validating page: Heritage statement 'Supporting applications for Listed Building Consent and Conservation Area Consent'; it also covers works affecting scheduled monuments or listed buildings and conservation area development.

issues.detail: Sustainable drainage (SuDS) details not captured. For major developments, drainage details are required at application (or pre-application) stage.
issues.evidence: Validating page, Drainage: 'New developments need a sustainable drainage system'; major developments must include drainage details.

issues.detail: Structural report by a qualified person not captured. It is required for works to TPO or conservation area trees where structural damage is the reason for the works. Grokbot shows 'Works to trees' as '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Validating page, tree work: 'we insist that a structural report to accompany the application is submitted by a qualified person'.

issues.detail: Renewable energy matrix not captured. It is required for major developments (10 or more dwellings, or 1,000 m2 or more of non-residential floor space), alongside the DAS. Grokbot read this page but did not extract the requirement.
issues.evidence: DAS page: major developments '(10+ dwellings or 1,000m2+ of non-residential floor space) should also complete a renewable energy matrix' (renewable_energy_matrix.pdf).

issues.detail: Two smaller items were not captured as requirements: Photographs ('when you think they are helpful') and the Site layout/block plan (1:500, north point). The block plan's drawing standard was captured, but the plan itself was not listed as a requirement.
issues.evidence: Validating page: 'Please include pictures when you think they are helpful'; site layout plan 'should be in metric scale (1:500), indicating the north'.

issues.detail: Four tab_items are page headers, context or boilerplate rather than requirements. They are: (1) 'Further guidance Preparing Heritage and Design and Access Statements v3.6 [pdf document] This page was last updated on 21 February 2025'; (2) 'Darlington BC - Validating your application Validating your application Ensure that all... In March 2022 Natural England identified...' (title plus a truncated fragment); (3) 'The whole of the Darlington Borough is located within the identified catchment area...' (background context); (4) 'See the latest advice on Nutrient Neutrality Validating your application When we receive the application...' (link text run into a heading).
issues.evidence: Tab section 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)' and 'Submission rules' items.

issues.detail: 'Nutrient Neutrality statement / calculator' has a trigger that is a navigation fragment and does not say when it applies. The source does not name a statement or calculator as a validation item. It only says that the whole borough is in the Teesmouth and Cleveland Coast SPA catchment and that nutrient impacts of development must be considered, with a link to separate advice. The requirement name and its placement under Full planning are Grokbot's invention.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'See the latest advice on Nutrient Neutrality Validating your application When we receive the application, we check...'

issues.detail: The DAS trigger excerpt begins with page-title noise ('Darlington BC - Design and Access Statements Design and Access Statements...'). It is also used unchanged for Full, Outline and LBC, although for full applications the new-dwelling and 100 m2 tests apply only within conservation areas.
issues.evidence: DAS page: required for 'major developments (full and outline) listed building applications developments within a conservation area for the provision of new dwelling(s), or a building where the floor space created is 100m2 or more'.

issues.detail: 'Floor plans / Elevations' is a national/general drawing item. The source applies it 'if appropriate' to any application, but Grokbot marked it 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. The same INFERRED placement was applied to Nutrient Neutrality. Householder, Demolition in cons area and Works to trees are shown as '(none)', although the heritage statement and structural report items above apply to them.
issues.evidence: Validating page: 'If appropriate, you should include floor plans and elevations.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the DAS topic sub-page, not a local list. Darlington currently publishes no local validation checklist: its documents are marked 'Currently being updated'. Grokbot's 7 extracted items are mostly page fragments and boilerplate, and it missed the heritage statement, SuDS, tree structural report and renewable energy matrix items given on the council's own pages.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
